name: artifact
description: Create or edit deliverable files in the WebUI Artifact workspace via patch (*** Begin Patch / *** End Patch). Paths are plain artifact file names. Use for reports, documents, and standalone files the user should inspect, not routine source edits. Publish an existing local file with present_artifact; read entries with read using artifact: paths.

patchText.description: Full patch text wrapped in *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch.
